task: Compute the sum of the first 4 prime numbers (2, 3, 5, 7) and store it via (rlm-set answer ...) then (rlm-set Final true).
lesson: Today I learned (filter even? (list 2 3 5 7)) incorrectly filters out all numbers because the predicate expects a single boolean argument, not a list.
